## Purpose and Entry Point
This is a documentation-only “awesome list” repository: it curates external cybersecurity agentic-AI resources rather than implementing an application or service. The canonical entry point and published artifact is [README.md](README.md), which organizes linked resources and short descriptions.

## Content Taxonomy
The primary architecture is the README’s category hierarchy:
- MCP servers for agent/tool integrations
- Research papers and platforms
- Security tools
- Agent frameworks
- Datasets
- Learning resources and communities

All curated entries are external URLs; the repository neither runs nor hosts the listed MCP servers, agents, scanners, APIs, or datasets. Source: [README.md](README.md).

## Contribution Boundary
Contributors modify the curated Markdown content under repository contribution rules. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) defines the expected contribution process, while [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) standardizes submitted changes. The key boundary is editorial: maintainers validate links, categorization, descriptions, and ordering rather than application behavior.

## Content Integrity Pipeline
Alphabetical ordering is the only explicit automated content-quality gate. The checker script at [scripts/check-alphabetical-order.sh](scripts/check-alphabetical-order.sh) validates ordering, and the GitHub Actions workflow at [.github/workflows/check-alphabetical-order.yml](.github/workflows/check-alphabetical-order.yml) executes it in CI. Control flow is: pull request or workflow trigger → GitHub Actions runner → shell checker → pass/fail status.

## Runtime and Infrastructure
There is no application runtime, package manifest, database, API server, or deployment configuration in this repository. Material infrastructure is GitHub hosting and GitHub Actions CI, with a POSIX-style shell execution environment for the ordering check. Paths: [.github/workflows/check-alphabetical-order.yml](.github/workflows/check-alphabetical-order.yml), [scripts/check-alphabetical-order.sh](scripts/check-alphabetical-order.sh).

## External-Service Model
The README links to third-party GitHub repositories, package registries, research archives, vendor sites, and dataset hosts. Those services are reference targets only; their availability, APIs, credentials, security posture, and execution environments remain outside this repository’s control. The repository’s principal operational risk is stale, malformed, duplicated, miscategorized, or non-alphabetized catalog content in [README.md](README.md).
